column2: Base Water Supply
Wilde taps the upper level fountains for you. Your faucet now serves base water, and it takes priority when several taps are available.
Core: Red Imp Brewery
You can order four bottles of Johnnie Walker from the Red Imp; you pay on delivery, with an extra 15% off the wholesale price.
Core: GP Mining Co-op
You can order perfect-purity metal ingots, 6 per delivery; you pay for them on delivery.
Core: Lower Level Chemist
You can order "Eternal" revitalizing essence and "Prime" pheromone perfume — 2 serums plus 1 perfume per delivery; you pay on delivery.
Core: Upper Level Pharma
You can order Immunivax injectors, 8 per delivery; you pay for them on delivery.
Scavenger Alliance
Tonight you get 5 extra scavenging attempts and cannot be injured. Junk chance -30%. One-shot favour with a 3 day cooldown.
Hydroponic Master
Wilde hires a hydroponic master to teach you. All hydroponic growth speed +30%, all DNA editors +30% faster.
Power Recycling
Wilde installs cutting-edge electromagnetic tech. Every running machine gains an additional 50% efficiency.
Electromagnetic Overclock
Wilde installs cutting-edge electromagnetic tech. Every running machine gains an additional 30% performance and 10% quality.
Automated Trap

Wilde installs an automated trap. A night thief who leaves empty-handed is caught and sent to Security; you gain 200 credits and 10 Security reputation. (The trap does nothing while the insurance service is locked or you have the Alert perk.)
Master Brewer
Wilde sends a master brewer to teach you. Your home-brewed wine scores +1. Works on wine added by other mods too.
Alcohol & Tobacco Wholesale
Alcohol and tobacco items sell for 25% more.
Doctrine of Water
Wilde quietly founds a private water cult for you. Selling water grants 33% more reputation and water prices rise 10%.

Wilde hooked you up with a vending drone. After closing, open the tablet and press the drone button to jump straight to Dr. Jackson's shop. The trip does not use up your night outing.

Ultimate Core Customer
You are now Dr. Jackson's most important partner. Every night he sends over one random item from his shop, delivered straight into your store inventory.
Ranch Master
Wilde found you a seasoned breeder. Your rats and all fish grow 20% faster.
Financing Guarantee
Wilde backs your financing. Unlocks the Financing Guarantee night service: pay 300 credits and a merchant will definitely visit the next day (contraband excluded). 3 day cooldown.

Black Market Shakeup
Wilde sends word down to the exchange. The list of goods is rerolled on the spot. 4-day cooldown.
The underground exchange rerolled its list.
Hacker Empire
Wilde found you a strange account. Every Wednesday morning three food stamps worth 160 appear in your stock.
The account paid out again: three food stamps worth 160.
Multi-Vote Parliament
Wilde has an informant speak for you at the Security Directorate's weekly council. Security reputation +15; if it is below 0 it is first set to 0. This favour has a 7 day cooldown.
Your informant spoke up at the Security council. Security reputation +15.
Military Power Unit
The recharger, the power block and the shared battery cabinet charge 400% faster. Every battery holds an extra 30 kJ (a 100 kJ cell becomes 130 kJ, a 500 kJ cell becomes 530 kJ).
The power lines were rebuilt to military spec.
Pre-Established Harmony I
Wilde's hand quietly moves everything behind the curtain. Luck permanently +10.
Pre-Established Harmony II
Wilde's people clear the road ahead of you. Luck permanently +10 again.
Pre-Established Harmony III
Your task now is to prove that Wilde is God. Luck permanently +10 again.
Master Brewer II
Your home brew gets better again (brewing score +1). Hand-made wine sells for 15% more. Works on wine added by other mods too.
Your wine got better, and pricier.
Master Brewer III
Your craft has peaked (brewing score +1). Your wine ages one extra time every day. Works on wine racks added by other mods too.
Every bottle on the rack is turning into legend.

The automated trap caught last night's thief. Security sent the bounty over.
Only changes the price of this Wilde Network upgrade. Vanilla network prices are not listed here and cannot be changed.
Cyber Bay Expansion I

You paid Dr. Jackson a hefty fee and he taught you his bay-expansion technique. Your machines' module bays can now go one row past the vanilla limit (5x7 -> 6x7). You still need the vanilla Module Bay Expansion Kit to actually expand a machine; buying this does not enlarge anything by itself.
Cyber Bay Expansion II

Another hefty fee, and Dr. Jackson handed over everything he had left. Your module bays can now reach the maximum size (7x7). The vanilla Module Bay Expansion Kit is still required for each expansion.
Johnnie Walker Whisky
Distilled from wheat grown in the upper nutrient vaults. Luxury, elegantly served.
The square bottle glows like amber under the lamp.
Special
Contraband Deal
Wilde opens a contraband channel for you: buy one restricted neural core module from Dr. Jackson. 7 day cooldown between purchases.
Modern Logistics Chain
Wilde sets up a modern delivery chain. Every ordering phone call has 1 day less cooldown.
Regional Supply Pact
Wilde signs a special supply pact. Every ordering phone call has 1 more day less cooldown, and all dividends you receive are doubled.
Quantum Printing
Wilde installs quantum printing in your store. Every order arrives next morning with the vanilla courier, ahead of all other customers.
Hemingway Cigarettes

Wilde introduces you to someone inside Pastel. You can now call 4614 to order Hemingway cigarettes: 6 packs at a time, 5 day cooldown. You pay the wholesale price on delivery, 15% off when you take the whole lot. Their business card is left on your counter.
Minor Shareholder: Pastel
You now hold shares in Pastel. Hemingway cigarettes get another 15% off wholesale (30% total), and every Wednesday morning 3 packs arrive as your dividend.

Ghost Water Supply
Wilde taps the mid-level water mains for you. Your faucet now serves ghost water.
Wilde's Fixer IV
Wilde hands you his last ace. Every night the fixer silences witnesses and destroys evidence: each crime value drops by 35% and another 1000 is wiped out. The nightly fee is 100.
When off, this service is hidden from Wilde's network panel. Anything you already bought keeps working. You can turn it back on anytime.
